sql:
SELECT
  order__channel
  , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
  , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel AS order__channel
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_7
GROUP BY
  order__channel
answer:
统计范围：青禾客户范围内，按下单日期统计2026年6月订单，并按订单渠道分组；结果列出小程序、门店两个渠道。

| 订单渠道 | 创建订单数（单） | 有效订单数（单） | 净销售额（分） |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 小程序 | 15194 | 13372 | 229553932 |
| 门店 | 15182 | 13218 | 225491256 |

口径：创建订单数按全部订单统计、每个订单号计一次，包含取消单；有效订单数为状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数，取消和全退不计；净销售额为 paid 订单实付减退款后的合计，取消单不计，按原订单下单日期归属，金额单位为分。
